words.gloss: will it not happen or befit?

literal: Will it not befit, the gossip known to the town? That has the nature of having obtained [him] without actually obtaining [him].
translation: Will not the gossip known to the entire town work in my favor? It has the unique nature of making me feel as if I have attained my lover, even before I have actually won him.
modern: ஊரார் அறிந்த இந்த அலர் (வதந்தி) எனக்கு நன்மை செய்யாதோ? என் காதலனை இன்னும் அடையப் பெறாத நிலையிலும், அவனை அடைந்துவிட்டது போன்ற இன்பத்தைத் தரும் தன்மையுடையது அது.
explanation: The heroine reflects on the public gossip spreading through the town regarding her secret love affair. Instead of being distressed by the rumors, she welcomes them. She explains that the gossip has a wonderful effect: it makes her feel as though she has already united with her lover, even before their formal marriage. The key words 'பெறாஅது' (without obtaining) and 'பெற்றன்ன' (as if obtained) highlight this sweet paradox where public exposure solidifies their bond in her heart.
